name: Mixed Vegetable Korma
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, cauliflower, peas)
1 bay leaf, 2 cardamom pods and 2 cloves
1 tsp coriander powder and ¼ tsp turmeric
steps: Heat the oil, add the whole spices, then the onion, and cook for 5 minutes until golden.
Add ginger, garlic and tomato and cook 4 minutes. Blend this base with the silken tofu to a smooth paste.
Return to the pan, add coriander powder, turmeric, the vegetables and 1 cup water.
Simmer covered for 12 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Add the tofu cubes for the last 5 minutes of simmering.
Stir in the coconut milk and garam masala, simmer 2 minutes, and finish with coriander.
note: A nut-free korma: the tofu and a little coconut milk replace the usual cashew and cream.
